record.one_liner: MongoDB Atlas Administration API allows developers to manage all components in MongoDB Atlas using OAuth 2.0 service accounts and HTTP Digest-based API keys.
record.blocker: No explicit self-service test access details provided in the source text.

auth_methods.quote:
The Atlas Administration API accepts the following authentication methods:

- Service account access tokens (OAuth 2.0)

- API keys (HTTP Digest Authentication)
